Title: Parent and toddler swim at Brentford Fountain
Address: Brentford Fountain Leisure Centre, 658 Chiswick High Road, Brentford
ScheduleText: Tue and Thu 09:00–09:45, "50+ and Parent & Toddler" session (shared with over-50s), 5 bookable spaces. Seen on the centre's pool timetable for 3 and 5 Nov 2026
PriceText: Adult £6.55 pay and play (child price not shown)
Description: Quieter pool session for parents with toddlers, shared with over-50s
NeedsInfo: Toddler age range and child price not stated; seen for one week only (3 and 5 Nov 2026). Book via the Lampton app or member booking
